horoscope: A positive attitude can give you the push you need today. The Moon in Taurus may turn your attention towards your career and responsibilities. Express your views confidently at work, but make sure you listen to others as well. Swimming, dancing or exercising could help you unwind. It's also a good time to bring a little more romance into your relationship.
love: If your partner gives excuses in every conversation, then Mercury suggests you think about their intentions. Having clarity about the future is very important for you. Our astrologers advise you to express your feelings clearly and not put one-sided effort into relationships.
finance: You may come across some good opportunities to increase your income today. Mercury could bring financial gains through a new project, job opportunity or business connection. Plans you have already made for your finances may also begin to move forward. Astrotalk astrologers recommend making good use of your earnings and thinking about investments for the future.
career: Mercury will help you put your thoughts across in a convincing yet tactful way today. People are likely to take your opinions seriously because of the confidence with which you speak. Our astrologers suggest using this to build a better understanding with your team and move your work forward.
health: Today, avoid eating spicy and street food, especially if you have acidity or digestion issues. Add light and nutritious food to your diet. Mercury encourages you to rethink your habits and routine. Our astrologer advises you to have meals according to your capabilities and consult a doctor if needed.
